description: Screenshot of a portion of an RT.com news article about the US-China trade war, circa summer 2019. The visible text reports Beijing rejecting Trump accusations and citing soybean purchases per Xinhua News Agency, recounts tariff escalations since 2018, and notes a tariff-hike pause after G20 talks. An embedded ALSO ON RT.COM promo box headlined about a temporary trade truce before the G20 summit shows a stock image of a heart-shaped red tree in a red flower field.
text: Beijing rejected Trump's accusations, insisting that China has purchased US agricultural products. It announced on Sunday that millions of tons of US soybeans have been shipped to China since July 19. According to Xinhua News Agency, Chinese companies are looking for soybeans, cotton, pork, and sorghum. China agreed earlier to narrow its multibillion-dollar trade surplus with the US by purchasing more American soybeans, natural gas, and other exports. The pledge was revoked after Trump started hiking tariffs last year. ALSO ON RT.COM. China & US agree to temporarily cease trade hostilities before G20 summit, sources say. The two countries have been locked in a trade war since 2018, when Washington slapped 25-percent tariffs on $50 billion worth of Chinese products, triggering a similar response from Beijing. Since then, the sides have exchanged several rounds of tit-for-tat levies. In June, the Trump administration increased tariffs on $250 billion worth of Chinese goods to 25 percent, and China hit back, raising tariffs up to the same rate on 5,000 US goods worth $60 billion. Beijing and Washington paused the tariff hike exchanges following talks between the two nations' leaders on the sidelines of the G20 summit last month.
flags: RT is a Russian state-controlled outlet; article claims reported as the outlet's claims

description: Three-panel meme headed by a quotation of Psalm 78:45. The left two panels are photographs of Hillary Clinton (speaking at a microphone) and Barack Obama, each captured at a moment when a fly landed on their face; the third panel is a drawing of Pepe the Frog, invoking the frogs of the verse. A MILO logo watermark appears at lower right, and '-CP' is written in the white margin below. The meme juxtaposes the biblical plague verse with the flies and the frog imagery.
text: "HE SENT AMONG THEM SWARMS OF FLIES, WHICH DEVOURED THEM, AND FROGS, WHICH DESTROYED THEM." PSALM 78:45. MILO. -CP
flags: Pepe the Frog imagery has been appropriated in some contexts as an extremist symbol; used here as a frog/plague pun
